items.title: AISI releases Transect, an open-source tool for reviewing long-horizon agent evaluations
items.summary_en: AISI describes Transect as an open-source Python package built on Inspect Scout, released with support from Meridian Labs. It turns long agent transcripts into one interactive report that puts events, token use, sub-agent activity and model-generated behaviour labels on a shared timeline. Reviewers can trace labels back to source turns and export the data. The example evaluation was an AI R&D task of almost 13 million tokens.
